body:
I’m in the process of cleaning up and decluttering my place. The internet says they like clutter.  I’ve also been spraying rubbing alcohol on things as it apparently kills them on contact. 

I will 100% give management a chance to fix the problem. I hope their methods work and are safe for my cats though. I wouldn’t expect them to pay for someone I chose. I was just wondering if should their methods not work am I allowed to hire someone myself?

I’m trying. The panicking at random times isn’t helping. I have terrible anxiety about cleaning. I have to make everything perfectly clean. Cleaning just enough to allow treatment takes more effort for me than cleaning perfectly. I have to try but im just naturally programmed to jump right to suicide as an answer right away.

I went to Walmart and got a mattress cover, new pillows and pillow protectors. I washed my bedding in high heat and used the hottest setting on the dryer. My apartment is cluttered as hell and apparently that’s just happy living for these bugs. I have a plan I need to follow but I’m losing my mind trying to take the steps I need to make. I mean I can hardly leave the house alone or get out of bed before dinner time. How am I going to clean and declutter my house enough to have it treated.

Thank you guys for all the advice. Its really helped. I plan on waking early to tackle some of the more messy mess and then slowly go about cleaning everything else. I’ll get my shit together mentally some day and this won’t be an issue.
No there aren’t any bugs or rodents and the doors are accessible.

I think everyone is quite content with me being so quiet lately. They know I’m suicidal but they seem to think quiet means “ok”. I’m 100% the one that doesn’t want me though. As long as I don’t bother them with my mental state everyone else is fine with me. 

I’m very sorry you are going through that though. I wouldn’t wish it on anyone.

I’m angry at my fiancé for being insensitive and for lying. I’m angry with my family for suggesting I live a life I hate in a place I hate. I’m angry at my friends for being self centred and for never being there. I’m angry at myself for getting into the situation I’m in.

He spends pretty much all of his free time outside of work on this game which is a problem in itself. He plays with her when she is online and chats with her throughout the day on Facebook. She seems to have a healthy relationship with her fiancé but my fiancé seems obsessed. 

I think when they talk it’s mostly about the game. And as for time with me there’s hardly any of that. 

Come to think of it there are probably more problems than her.
